en: Color postcard showing an alpine village with scattered chalets and farmhouses on green rolling meadows, a winding road, conifer forests, and dramatic rocky peaks of a mountain massif in the background under a partly cloudy blue sky. The settlement has red and brown roofs typical of alpine architecture. A faint circular postmark is visible near the bottom center of the image, but no legible printed title or caption appears on the front.
